and go into the land that I will show to you.’
Then he went away from the land of the Chaldeans,
God brought him into this land,
Et non dedit illi hæreditatem in ea,
And he gave him no inheritance in it,
not even the space of one step.
sed repromisit dare illi eam in possessionem,
But he promised to give it to him as a possession,
and to his offspring after him,
though he did not have a son.
Then God told him that his offspring would be a settler in a foreign land,
Quia erit semen ejus accola in terra aliena,
and that they would subjugate them,
et male tractabunt eos annis quadringentis:

et servient mihi in loco isto.
they shall depart and shall serve me in this place.’
And he gave him the covenant of circumcision.
et sic genuit Isaac, et circumcidit eum die octavo:
And so he conceived Isaac and circumcised him on the eighth day.
being jealous, sold Joseph into Egypt.
et eripuit eum ex omnibus tribulationibus ejus,

et dedit ei gratiam et sapientiam in conspectu pharaonis regis Ægypti:
And he gave him grace and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh,
et constituit eum præpositum super Ægyptum,

Venit autem fames in universam Ægyptum et Chanaan,
Then a famine occurred in all of Egypt and Canaan,
et non inveniebant cibos patres nostri.
And our fathers did not find food.
Cum audisset autem Jacob esse frumentum in Ægypto,
But when Jacob had heard that there was grain in Egypt,
et in secundo cognitus est Joseph a fratribus suis,
And on the second occasion, Joseph was recognized by his brothers,
et manifestatum est Pharaoni genus ejus.
and his ancestry was made manifest to Pharaoh.
Then Joseph sent for and brought his father Jacob,
accersivit Jacob patrem suum et omnem cognationem suam,
And they crossed over into Shechem,
and they were placed in the sepulcher which Abraham bought for a sum of money from the sons of Hamor,
quod emit Abraham pretio argenti a filiis Hemor filii Sichem.
Cum autem appropinquaret tempus promissionis quam confessus erat Deus Abrahæ,
And when the time of the Promise that God had revealed to Abraham drew near,
quoadusque surrexit alius rex in Ægypto,

afflixit patres nostros ut exponerent infantes suos,
afflicted our fathers, so that they would expose their infants,
In the same time, Moses was born.
And he was in the grace of God,
qui nutritus est tribus mensibus in domo patris sui.
and he was nourished for three months in the house of his father.
the daughter of Pharaoh took him in,
et nutrivit eum sibi in filium.
and she raised him as her own son.
Et eruditus est Moyses omni sapientia Ægyptiorum,
And Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians.
et erat potens in verbis et in operibus suis.
And he was mighty in his words and in his deeds.
Cum autem impleretur ei quadraginta annorum tempus,
But when forty years of age were completed in him,
ascendit in cor ejus ut visitaret fratres suos filios Israël.
it rose up in his heart that he should visit his brothers, the sons of Israel.
Et cum vidisset quemdam injuriam patientem,
And when he had seen a certain one suffering injury,
et fecit ultionem ei qui injuriam sustinebat,
he wrought a retribution for him who was enduring the injury.
Existimabat autem intelligere fratres, quoniam Deus per manum ipsius daret salutem illis:
Now he supposed that his brothers would understand that God would grant them salvation through his hand.
But they did not understand it.
Sequenti vero die apparuit illis litigantibus:
So truly, on the following day, he appeared before those who were arguing,
et reconciliabat eos in pace, dicens:
and he would have reconciled them in peace,
So why would you harm one another?’
But he who was causing the injury to his neighbor rejected him,
Quis te constituit principem et judicem super nos?
Could it be that you want to kill me,
in the same way that you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
Fugit autem Moyses in verbo isto:
Then, at this word, Moses fled.
et factus est advena in terra Madian,
And he became a foreigner in the land of Midian,
Et expletis annis quadraginta, apparuit illi in deserto montis Sina angelus in igne flammæ rubi.
And when forty years were completed, there appeared to him, in the desert of Mount Sinai, an Angel, in a flame of fire in a bush.
Moses was amazed at the sight.
And as he drew near in order to gaze at it,
facta est ad eum vox Domini,
the voice of the Lord came to him,
‘I am the God of your fathers:
And Moses, being made to tremble,
But the Lord said to him:
locus enim in quo stas, terra sancta est.
For the place in which you stand is holy ground.
Videns vidi afflictionem populi mei qui est in Ægypto,
Certainly, I have seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt,
and I have heard their groaning.
And so, I am coming down to free them.
Et nunc veni, et mittam te in Ægyptum.
And now, go forth and I will send you into Egypt.’
Quis te constituit principem et judicem?
‘Who has appointed you as leader and judge?’
hunc Deus principem et redemptorem misit,
is the one God sent to be leader and redeemer,
cum manu angeli qui apparuit illi in rubo.
by the hand of the Angel who appeared to him in the bush.
Hic eduxit illos faciens prodigia et signa in terra Ægypti,
This man led them out, accomplishing signs and wonders in the land of Egypt,
and in the desert, for forty years.
who said to the sons of Israel:
Prophetam suscitabit vobis Deus de fratribus vestris,
‘God will raise up for you a prophet like me from your own brothers.
Hic est qui fuit in ecclesia in solitudine cum angelo,
This is he who was in the Church in the wilderness,
qui loquebatur ei in monte Sina,
with the Angel who was speaking to him on Mount Sinai,
qui accepit verba vitæ dare nobis.
It is he who received the words of life to give to us.

et aversi sunt cordibus suis in Ægyptum,
and in their hearts they turned away toward Egypt,

qui eduxit nos de terra Ægypti,
who led us away from the land of Egypt,

And so they fashioned a calf in those days,
and they offered sacrifices to an idol,

and they rejoiced in the works of their own hands.

figures which you yourselves formed in order to adore them.

sicut disposuit illis Deus loquens ad Moysen,
just as God ordained for them, speaking to Moses,
ut faceret illud secundum formam quam viderat.
so that he would make it according to the form that he had seen.

et petiit ut inveniret tabernaculum Deo Jacob.
and who asked that he might obtain a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.

Yet the Most High does not live in houses built by hands,

and the earth is my footstool.

aut quis locus requietionis meæ est?

Nonne manus mea fecit hæc omnia?

Dura cervice, et incircumcisis cordibus et auribus,
Stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears,
you ever resist the Holy Spirit.
Quem prophetarum non sunt persecuti patres vestri?

et occiderunt eos qui prænuntiabant de adventu Justi,

cujus vos nunc proditores et homicidæ fuistis:
